citation: Lawrence, J. (2026). A crosswalk between the "1000 i 1 slovo" A1 and A2 lexical minimums and the validated Ukrainian Vocabulary Profile (v1.3.0). jakelawrence.xyz/research/ukrainian-frequency.

classes.agree: the volume and the validated level are the same
classes.earlier: the minimum teaches it earlier than the profile validates it
classes.later: the minimum teaches it later than the profile validates it
classes.absent: validated A1 or A2, and neither volume carries it
classes.beyond: validated B1 or higher and outside the minimums, as expected
classes.unprofiled: in a volume, and the profile does not cover it
